title: incident-bot: enrich oncall context with automated SLO runbook linking and diagnostics hints
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: On-call engineers need faster context when SLOs alert. This PR extends incident-bot and the SLO toolkit to automatically surface relevant runbook links and a short diagnostics hint summary in oncall notifications. Changes include: (1) runbook linking: map SLO/alert IDs to curated runbook links stored in the SLO registry and attach them to Slack/PagerDuty messages; (2) diagnostics hints: lightweight heuristics that summarize common diagnostics (e.g. high 95th latency, repeated retry errors, KV cache miss spike) based on recent telemetry and embed a 2-3 bullet hint in the incident message; (3) UI/console: a small alert-detail panel shows the linked runbook, recent telemetry snippets and one-click 'open runbook' action; (4) backwards compatible: behavior is opt-in per-schedule/alert-rule and falls back to current payload when registry entries are missing. Checklist: - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] e2e message formatting tests - [x] docs update (runbooks.md + incident-bot README) - [x] Linear tickets linked. Testing & rollout: validated in staging with synthetic SLO fires and smoke tests across Slack + PD routes; feature gated by incident-bot flag and staged rollout to 10% of teams then 100%. Rollback: feature flag off restores prior payload. Related: ENG-4123 SRE-218.
